contract: Compare delivered packets from advance with pop, advance_ready with pop, and a pump with a sink that retires each feed immediately.
Compare MOV packets in the demux view and the first video track of each Matroska startup and backward-seek capsule. Fold track, PTS, DTS, duration, flags, size and payload.

For a Matroska seek, the reference folds its own backward seek: the video packets it reads from its landing on. The candidate folds the packets its player delivers, which start at the landing Cluster's first video packet.
For the edited forward MOV cases also fold position, time base and encoded trim.

open_deviations.reading: Seek policy the specification leaves open, with the nanosecond AVC DefaultDuration
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 sets no seek landing: the player starts a Matroska seek at the first video packet of the landing Cluster (crates/playback README, delivery comparison), the demuxer's backward seek at the cue's key packet; section 5.1.4.1.13 gives DefaultDuration in nanoseconds
open_deviations.candidate: delivers the landing Cluster's four video packets before its key packet (in avc-seek-700, presented at 500 to 625 ms before the 667 ms key), then keeps 41666666 ns durations
open_deviations.reference: starts at the key packet without them; on the common packets it publishes 41000000 ns, DefaultDuration truncated to its 1 ms Segment tick
